title: Qwen3-235B-A22B UD-Q2_K_XL GGUF on llama.cpp: 128GB unified memory
slug_note: The only single-machine resident lane: unsloth's ~2-bit dynamic GGUF at 88GB on a 128GB Mac or Spark.

engine.config: llama-server with all layers offloaded; context capped so KV fits the ~40GB left after weights

requirements.notes: 88GB weights + KV at 8-16K context; growing the context pushes a 128GB box into swap.

steps: brew install llama.cpp (or build with Metal/CUDA)

caveats: The model exceeds the RAM of every machine in this directory at BF16 (470GB) and at any quant above ~2 bits; it only runs locally via heavy quantization, SSD expert streaming, or a multi-GPU split.
No sourced speed number exists for this lane, so the row stays untested.
Quality loss at ~2 bits per weight on a 235B MoE is not characterized in our sources.
